definitions.full: H1532. gallab [ גַּלָּב ] noun [masculine] barber (Phoenician גלב CIS i, 257 ff. ) — Ezek 5:1 הַגַּלָּבִים תַּעַר .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to shave;

occurrences.englishText: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
